title: Baked Fish with Moroccan Sellou Crust
description: A delicious Italian-inspired dish featuring flaky fish topped with a crispy, sweet, and spicy Moroccan sellou crust. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
In a bowl, mix together the crushed sellou and melted molten chocolate.
Dip each fish fillet into the sellou-chocolate mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated fish fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with indulgent panko breadcrumbs.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and the sellou crust is golden brown.
